attrs.text: Morse A-Z: hold Q (Ready). Tap W: short = dot, about 1 s = dash. The lights show the letter number (A=1 ... Z=26). Let go of Q to clear.
Clock = 10 ticks per second. Every flip-flop updates on each tick (gray wires).
1  TAP TIMER: counts 0,1,2,3 while W is held (3 = long = dash)
2  RELEASE: R = one tick when W is let go.  H = keep,  RDOT / RDASH = a dot / dash just ended
3  LETTER STEPS: one flip-flop per letter.  next = (dot or dash AND parent letter) OR (H AND itself).  Wrong tap = all off.
4  NUMBER LIGHTS: each light is an OR ladder of the letters whose number has that bit.  Ready = Q (OUT6)   Tap = Q and W (OUT7)
